heading: Availability of appropriations: exchange fees; losses in accounts
lead: Amounts appropriated to the Department of Defense may be used for—

tree.text: losses in the accounts of disbursing officials and agents in accordance with law.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Section is based on Pub. L. 99–190, § 101(b) [title VIII, § 8006(c)], Dec. 19, 1985, 99 Stat. 1185, 1203.
